data.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

We are hiring an early-career Automation Engineer to support Granicus Technical Support’s transition to an AI-first operation, where AI handles a growing share of customer interactions end-to-end. This role focuses on helping build, test, and deploy production-ready AI automations across Forethought, Salesforce, and Microsoft Copilot to improve AI resolution rate, reduce manual work, and enhance customer experience through scalable, reliable support workflows.

Essential Function

  • Help build AI-powered automations across Forethought, Salesforce, and Microsoft Copilot.
  • Support the design of workflows for auto-resolution, case enrichment, and routing.
  • Rapidly prototype, test, deploy, and iterate on scoped automation solutions.
  • Contribute to improvements in AI resolution rate and overall automation coverage.
  • Help reduce manual work across support operations through effective automation design.
  • Partner with Support, CX, and AI teams to translate operational needs into practical solutions.
  • Continuously improve automation performance using data, feedback, and iterative learning.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Deliver multiple scoped, production-ready AI automations within the first 3–6 months, with appropriate guidance and support.
  • Contribute to measurable improvement in AI resolution rate and automation coverage.
  • Help reduce manual case handling and improve operational efficiency across support workflows.
  • Demonstrate growing ability to design, deploy, and improve automation solutions with increasing independence.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Foundational experience building AI workflows or automations.
  • Exposure to APIs, scripting, or automation tools.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them in practical support scenarios.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a sense of ownership and accountability.

Experience/Credentials:

  • Experience with Salesforce or customer support tools is preferred.
  • Exposure to AI platforms such as Forethought, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent solutions is preferred.
  • Familiarity with automation or low-code platforms is preferred.
  • Background in technical, engineering, or data-related fields is preferred.
  • Candidates must demonstrate at least one working AI automation or project and be prepared to walk through it during interviews.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

You Will Love This Job If You Have

  • You are a builder who turns ideas into working solutions quickly.
  • You are outcome-driven and focused on measurable impact.
  • You are comfortable working in ambiguity and moving fast.
  • You are curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Culture

  • At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to bea part of our journey.
  • A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices
  • Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important andsometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work-life balance and current affairs.
  • Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
  • We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employeepopulation

The Impact

  • We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

data.description:
Overview

At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. Behind every successful facility, procedure or innovation is a team of 15,000+ professionals working together, learning from each other and living out the mission, vision and values that define our organization.

As part of Optum, SCA Health is redefining specialty care by developing more accessible, patient-centered practice solutions for a network of more than 370 ambulatory surgical centers, over 400 specialty physician practice clinics and numerous labs and surgical hospitals. Our work spans a broad spectrum of services, all designed to support physicians, health systems and employers in delivering efficient, value-based care to patients without compromising quality or autonomy.

What sets SCA Health apart isn’t just what we do, it’s how we do it. Each decision we make is rooted in seven core values:

  • Clinical quality
  • Integrity
  • Service excellence
  • Teamwork
  • Accountability
  • Continuous improvement
  • Inclusion

Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.

At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, to learn more about our benefits.

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.


Responsibilities

The Technical Lead drives the technical direction of our engineering team, ensuring the delivery and ongoing support of scalable, high quality, and reliable software solutions. This role blends hands on engineering, architecture, leadership, and production support ownership, guiding developers through the full lifecycle, from design and build to deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence.

This position is ideal for someone passionate about building and supporting customer‑facing applications in a highly available, production‑ready environment. The Technical Lead leverages Agile principles, DevOps practices, modern cloud‑native technologies, and AI‑enabled capabilities to improve developer productivity, system reliability, operational efficiency, and service quality. A strong problem solver who balances technical depth with business awareness and responsible AI adoption will thrive in this role.

Key Responsibilities

The Technical Lead will have a broad set of responsibilities including, but not limited to, the following:

Technical Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead a team of onshore and offshore engineers through design, development, code reviews and releases of .NET applications.
  • Translate complex business problems into technical solutions
  • Lead large software initiatives from ideation through delivery, deployment, and post production stabilization.
  • Play a critical role in architecture, design, and technical decision making, with a strong emphasis on reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Write well designed, well tested, readable, and maintainable code aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Participate in and lead code reviews to ensure quality, consistency, and knowledge sharing.
  • Improve adherence to coding standards, test practices, secure coding techniques, and architectural guidelines.
  • Evaluate and adopt AI‑enabled tools and frameworks (e.g., developer copilots, AI‑assisted testing, code quality, and observability tools) to improve engineering efficiency and solution quality.

Cross Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with App dev, PMO, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders to:
    • Define and maintain a technically feasible roadmap
    • Scope, design, and deliver solutions addressing business needs
    • Balance feature delivery with stability and supportability
  • Build strong relationships across teams, creating and maintaining trust with business Stakeholders
  • Communicate technical and AI‑related concepts clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

People & Process Leadership

  • Possess strong interpersonal and leadership skills
  • Mentor and coach engineers, with focus on production ownership, operational awareness, and engineering maturity.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence.
  • Champion Agile best practices, including CI/CD, test driven development, and continuous improvement of delivery and support processes.
  • Act as an AI change agent, guiding the team through the evolving AI landscape and helping engineers adopt AI tools effectively and responsibly.


Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field required
  • Master’s degree preferred

Experience

  • 2+ years of proven success as a Technical Lead in application development space
  • 8+ years of experience with Microsoft stack technologies:
    • NET/ .NET Core, C#, Visual Studio, Entity Framework, SQL Server
  • Front end technologies:
    • JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS
    • Angular (v18), React (v16)
  • Cloud & DevOps:
    • Azure services (Functions, Service Bus, Key Vault, etc.) or equivalent
    • Azure DevOps
    • CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Strong experience building component based, responsive web applications.
  • Experience supporting enterprise scale production systems, preferably in regulated industries (Healthcare preferred).
  • Experience with:
    • Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)
    • Transactional databases and caching strategies
    • Test driven development, unit/integration testing
    • Public and internal APIs, integration frameworks
    • Microservices and event driven architectures
    • Performance tuning and troubleshooting production systems
    • Secure software development practices
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence without authority.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong balance of technical depth, operational mindset, and business priorities.
  • Experience with AI assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Azure OpenAI, AI based code quality or observability tools).

Preferred / Nice to Have Qualifications

  • Experience with AI assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Azure OpenAI, AI based code quality or observability tools).
  • Exposure to AI/ML enabled features such as intelligent search, recommendations, chatbots, or automation within enterprise applications.

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We’re looking for a Senior Java Backend Developer to join a CI&T squad working on a financial services client. You’ll help modernise an established Java web platform. That means building new services and APIs, keeping the existing platform stable, and gradually moving legacy functionality onto a cleaner architecture. You’ll work closely with frontend developers, QA, a Product Owner and a Tech Lead, using agile practices.

- Design, build and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs in Java

data.title: 🇩🇪 Software-Architect / System-Designer (100% Remote / German-Speaking)
data.description:
Fluent German is required for this role. Our customers are property management companies in Germany.

We're seeking an experienced Software architect / Full-Stack Developer who thinks like a Systems Designer – someone who reaches for schema diagrams and load assumptions before reaching for code. You'll join our fully remote team. If you like complexity, enjoy reasoning about data, scale and reliability, want to implement AI-solutions and enjoy working with Claude, this could be the right role for you.

What you'll do

  • Own the system design – you decide how data is modeled, where state lives, how components talk to each other, and how the whole system behaves under load. You stay responsible for it once it's live.

  • Make the hard, hard-to-reverse design decisions early – and reason explicitly about the trade-offs behind them

  • Design and own our data layer from the ground up for new features – tables and relationships, indexing strategy, and query/load optimization that holds up as data and traffic grow

  • Design queues, background jobs and long-running workflows that stay correct and reliable under heavy load and partial failure

  • Talk to customers to understand how they actually use the product, and bring that into architecture decisions, the direction of our stack and the overall product vision

  • Work independently in an AI-first development setup with Claude

About Us

is an all-in-one platform for property management companies with features like an Inbox, CRM, Documents, Telephony, Video Calls, Team Chat and AI-Agents. We want to automate as much of a property manager's daily work as we can.

Our tech stack

Everything is TypeScript. From our database schema to the frontend.

Backend: Convex (Database & serverless functions)

Frontend: , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Salary

  • $1500 - $3000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

  • Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • 100% remote work

  • Allianz Gold Health Insurance with great coverage

  • Flexible hours

  • As many AI-tokens as you need

  • We’re self-funded & profitable (and not burning VC money to survive)

  • Small team, real ownership — what you build actually goes live

  • Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval to get through

Our special Health Program

  • Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

  • Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

  • Partner and kids are covered as well

  • Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

  • Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

  • $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

  • $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

  • Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our values

  • Get things done, every day matters

  • Transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

  • High standards for our own work and each other's

For a closer look at what we're building, check out our YouTube channel — heads up, it's in German.

Requirements

  • Fluent German, spoken and written

  • A genuine systems-design background – you can design a database from scratch (tables, relationships, indexes) and reason about database load, query performance and data growth, not just write CRUD against an existing schema

  • The instinct to think in terms of consistency, throughput, failure modes and bottlenecks – you know where the system will hurt before it does

  • Comfort designing queues, background jobs and long-running workflows, and the judgment to make the hard design trade-offs they involve

  • You treat reliability, scalability and maintainability as default concerns. If you've read "Designing Data-Intensive Applications" (Kleppmann) – or simply think that way – you'll feel right at home here

  • Solid English skills for smooth communication within the team

  • You work autonomously and take full ownership of your tasks

  • You're comfortable talking to customers to understand what they actually need

Your techstack:

is not important to us, since AI will be writing 100% of your code.

data.description:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Nick Guardino, Senior Director of Marketing Ops at Customer.io, and I'm looking for a GTM AI Engineer to help take our AI agents from scrappy prototypes to production-grade systems our GTM teams can depend on.

Over the last 3.5 months, our GTM AI team has built 11 agents now running in production, serving 120 active users and roughly 25,000 tool calls a day — all through custom CLIs that work, but weren't built to scale. We believe businesses can run leaner and go further when they deploy AI agents well, and we're figuring out that motion in real time. This role owns the scale and reliability layer so the rest of the team can keep building.

What we value

  • Craft over quick wins — energized by making things robust, not just making them work.
  • A point of view — we want someone who asks "why did you build it that way?" and has a specific answer for what to do instead.
  • Comfortable being wrong — you try things fast, and you course-correct just as fast.
  • AI-native by default — you'd rather direct Claude to write and QA code than write it by hand.

What you'll do

  • Database administration — own how agents read from and write to our databases, safely and at scale.
  • Fleet maintenance — monitor agent behavior in production, triage issues, and ship the steady stream of improvements that make an agent indispensable rather than just useful.
  • Partner closely with the GTM AI team — free up our agent builders to stay in their zero-to-one wheelhouse while you own scale and reliability.

data.description:
Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io. We're always looking for thoughtful, driven Engineering Managers to add to our org. Some of our teams are building customer-facing product and workflows; others keep our distributed systems reliable, observable, and ready to scale. Whichever kind of problem energizes you, if you lead people well, hold a high technical bar, and drive work to completion without waiting to be handed a plan, we want to hear from you.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies—from scrappy startups to global brands—use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data—what people do or don't do inside a web or mobile app. Under the hood: Go, React, and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What we value

Ownership. You set direction and see initiatives through. You create clarity when things are murky and set the path forward rather than waiting for one to be defined, and you're motivated by impact—not just intention. You hold yourself and your team accountable to shipping, not just staying busy.

Leaders who can do both. You operate at the strategic level and stay close to the technical work. You can align stakeholders on a plan and earn your engineers' respect in the same day—you don't choose between vision and execution, you hold both.

A drive to execute through resistance. Competing priorities, skeptical stakeholders, tired teams—you've moved work forward anyway. You name the resistance, make the call, and own the milestones and the misses.

An AI-first mindset. AI is central to how you build and how you lead your team to build. You have a real, concrete point of view on AI-native development, you use agentic tooling yourself, and you bring it into how your squad operates.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done." You bring rigor and pragmatism. Best practices matter—but never more than forward motion. You know when to build, when to buy, and when to wait—and you're comfortable making the call with incomplete information, then adjusting as you learn.

What you'll do

  • Care deeply about our customers and their outcomes
  • Lead your squad to deliver real customer value by owning projects end to end—from planning through delivery, quality, and follow-through
  • Drive execution: set milestones, keep work moving through ambiguity and competing priorities, and ship in small, observable increments rather than waiting for a release window
  • Make confident decisions when the path isn't obvious, and lead your team through them
  • Set the operating rhythm that helps your team move fastest, rather than defaulting to ceremony for its own sake
  • Ensure your squad's solutions are scalable, architecturally sound, flexible, and secure, with strong peer-review, QA, documentation, deployment, logging, and monitoring practices
  • Stay close to the work—jump into design reviews, architecture calls, and incidents rather than watching from a distance
  • Provide direct, timely, and specific coaching, and create meaningful development opportunities for your direct reports
  • Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the reliability of the systems you build
  • Hire, onboard, and manage performance so the right people are in place to hit your squad's goals
  • Bring an AI-native perspective—use AI tools to accelerate the team's velocity and help everyone prototype faster and ship smarter
  • Partner across engineering and other departments to align efforts with customer success, and reach higher when our customers are having a bad day

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years managing engineers at a SaaS company (B2B or B2C), ideally early-to-mid-stage
  • A track record of driving execution—concrete delivery outcomes with milestones, dates, and "I drove" ownership, especially in complex or fast-moving environments
  • A strong technical background—you can hold your own in architecture conversations and design reviews, represent your squad's technical choices across the company, and you've shipped real work recently enough to stay credible
  • Comfort operating with high autonomy and little prescribed structure—you create your own clarity and make difficult tradeoffs between competing priorities
  • Demonstrated AI-native leadership—not just personal fluency, but bringing AI-first practices into how your team builds
  • Experience building high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative teams
  • Clear, concise, and direct communication, both verbal and written

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $185,000-$215,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. Application - We review everyone with care.
  2. Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let's chat about what you're looking for, your leadership style, and how we work.
  3. Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Deep dive into your experience leading teams, your technical philosophy, and how you think about building organizations.
  4. People Partner Interview (30 mins) - Explore your leadership style, management philosophy, and approach to supporting high-performing teams with our engineering people partner.
  5. Technical Interview (60 mins) - Engage in a collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges.
  6. Take-Home Assignment - Submit a short written retrospective on a project you’ve led as an Engineering Manager.
  7. Retrospective Review Call (60 mins) - We’ll use your written submission as the foundation for a deeper conversation.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the Role

We are seeking Field Integration Engineers who excel at connecting software engineering, customer interaction, and hands-on field operations. In this position, you will drive the full-stack integration and deployment of our software solutions across customer hardware, physical vehicles, and test benches.

Serving as the key technical expert on-site, mainly in the great Chicago area, you will ensure our software operates seamlessly on customer vehicles. You will bring up target hardware, SIL, and HIL setups; troubleshoot integration challenges spanning software, firmware, and vehicle networks; and partner directly with customer systems and software engineering teams to deliver production-ready autonomous and intelligent vehicle technology.

Travel Expectation: This position requires significant travel (30%–50%+) to customer facilities, proving grounds, test tracks, and active field deployment sites.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Deploy, configure, and integrate vehicle software stack, middleware, and application-level code on customer target hardware, HIL simulators, and vehicle platforms.

  • Serve as the primary technical escalation point on-site. Collect logs/telemetry, bisect software pipelines, debug system crashes, and isolate root causes across software-hardware boundaries.

  • Debug and validate communication interfaces (CAN, LIN, Automotive Ethernet, J1939) and verify end-to-end data flow between sensors, ECUs, and application software.

  • Partner closely with internal core software/firmware engineering teams to reproduce complex field issues, validate fixes, and push continuous system improvements.

  • Write Python scripts, Bash automation, and internal tooling to streamline deployment, automated diagnostics, and log collection in field environments.

  • Work directly with customer engineering leadership to define target integration use-cases, articulate system constraints, and establish clear integration milestones.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

  • Strong programming skills in embedded C and/or C++, with solid software engineering practices in Linux development and command-line environments.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, and debugging software applications on physical target platforms or embedded hardware.

  • Practical understanding of automotive or industrial network topologies, protocol analysis (CAN, Ethernet, J1939), and diagnostic standards (UDS, DoIP, OBD-II).

  • Strong analytical skills to systematically isolate faults across multi-component software pipelines and hardware interfaces.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the confidence to represent the engineering team in fast-paced, high-stakes customer environments.

  • Ability and willingness to travel 30%–50%+ to domestic and international customer locations and testing sites.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with vehicle platforms, autonomous systems, robotics, or active industrial/field environments.

  • Familiarity with AUTOSAR platform concepts (RTE, SWCs, ARXML), SIL/HIL test rigs, or ROS/ROS2 architecture.

  • Experience using network analysis tools (e.g., Vector CANoe/CANape, Wireshark, PEAK-System) or hardware debugging tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters).

  • Scripting capability in Python for data processing, log parsing, or test automation.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

data.title: AI Solutions Engineer / Product Builder
data.description:
Overview

The Business Technology team, which reports to the CIO, is building intelligent internal tools that help our clinical, operational, and financial teams work faster and make better decisions across ~850 clinics and 40+ brands. This is a business need supported by technology — not a “tech for tech’s sake” initiative.

We’re looking for an AI Solutions Engineer / Product Builder who can take a messy business problem, turn it into a clear technical plan, and ship something useful quickly. You’ll work hands-on with business leaders across ClinOps, Finance, HR, Marketing, and other teams to design and build practical tools, workflows, and AI-enabled solutions.

This is a builder role. You’ll spend most of your time creating, testing, debugging, and improving solutions, often with the help of AI tools that amplify your output. We want someone who is comfortable moving quickly, learning new systems, and figuring things out without waiting for perfect instructions.

Our current environment includes modern internal automation and solution-engineering platforms, with TypeScript as the primary build language and Python used where needed. Prior experience with our exact platforms is not required; what matters most is that you can adapt fast, build well, and solve real problems.

What You’ll Build
You’ll work on a mix of internal products, automations, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows, including:
AI Agents — role-specific assistants for procurement, operations, clinical education, and other business functions
Automations — multi-step workflows triggered by schedules, emails, forms, and webhooks
Internal Web Apps — React-based dashboards, forms, and operational tools
Data Infrastructure — PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and datasets that power internal tools
Agent-Orchestrated Workflows — solutions that combine data, tools, and memory to solve multi-step problems
Data Pipelines — ingesting and transforming data across internal and external sources
Custom Microservices — lightweight services, APIs, and tools that extend what the team can do

Mindset & Approach

  • Business First:You’re energized by turning messy business processes into clear, logical systems.
  • Product-Minded Builder: You think about the user, the workflow, and the outcome — not just the code.
  • Fearless Problem Solver:You’re comfortable with ambiguity, you push forward without perfect instructions, and you know how to course-correct when the first version isn’t quite right.

data.description:
Who we are

Zus is a shared health data platform designed to accelerate healthcare data interoperability by providing easy-to-use patient data via API, embedded components, and direct EHR integrations. Founded in 2021 by Jonathan Bush, co-founder and former CEO of athenahealth, Zus partners with HIEs and other data networks to aggregate patient clinical history and then translates that history into user-friendly information at the point of care. Zus's mission is to catalyze healthcare's greatest inventors by maximizing the value of patient insights - so that they can build up, not around.

What we're looking for

We’re hiring a Staff Integrations Engineer to operate as a high-impact individual contributor at the intersection of software engineering and solution delivery. This is a deeply hands-on role: you’ll write production-grade code, build and operate data systems, and own the technical strategy and execution of complex customer integrations.

You’ll lead integrations across HIEs, EHRs, claims systems, labs, and other healthcare data sources. This includes turning ambiguous requirements into clear designs, building secure and reliable data pipelines, and ensuring ongoing system performance through monitoring and observability.

You’ll also serve as a senior technical advisor to customers—guiding architecture decisions, troubleshooting issues, and shaping how integrations are implemented. This role is for someone who builds and improves systems, not just configures them.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the stack: parsing messy HL7 payloads, building services in Go, scripting in Python, and leading technical conversations with customers.

Key responsibilities:

    Lead and Deliver Integrations

    • Own end-to-end delivery of customer integrations, including State HIE and ADT feeds—from scoping through production support

    • Design and implement data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and delivery

    • Build roster management workflows (ingestion, reconciliation, lifecycle management)

    • Architect reliable and scalable data transmission mechanisms (APIs, SFTP, event-driven systems)

    • Establish automated QA and validation frameworks to ensure data integrity

      • Act as a Technical Advisor

      • Partner with customers to design integration approaches and guide technical decisions

      • Translate ambiguous requirements into clear, implementable solutions

      • Advise on interoperability best practices and system architecture

      • Align customer needs with platform capabilities

        • Troubleshoot and Improve Systems

        • Serve as an escalation point for complex integration and data pipeline issues

        • Debug across the full stack, from transformation logic to downstream delivery

        • Identify root causes and implement durable, code-driven fixes

        • Reduce operational overhead by eliminating recurring issues through automation

          • Build Internal Systems and Tooling

          • Develop monitoring and observability systems for integration health

          • Create alerting, dashboards, and automated diagnostics

          • Build internal tools to accelerate implementation, QA, and troubleshooting

          • Continuously improve the scalability and reliability of integration systems

You’re a good fit because you have:

    • 7+ years of experience in software, integrations, or forward-deployed engineering

    • Strong programming skills (Python, Go, or similar) with a track record of building production systems

    • Experience with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR, ADT, CDA

    • AI-native development

    • Proven ability to design and build data pipelines and integrations—not just configure them

    • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, messy datasets

    • Experience building monitoring and observability systems

    • Ability to debug complex distributed systems end-to-end

    • Experience working directly with customers in a technical, consultative role

    • Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences

    • Strong ownership and ability to independently drive ambiguous problems to completion

    • Familiarity with security and compliance requirements (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2)

    • A desire to improve healthcare data infrastructure

We will offer you…

• Competitive compensation that reflects the value you bring to the team a combination of cash and equity

• Robust benefits that include health insurance, wellness benefits, 401k with a match, unlimited PTO

• Opportunity to work alongside a passionate team that is determined to help change the world (and have fun doing it)

Please Note: Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don’t apply unless they meet 100% of the job criteria. While we have worked to consolidate the minimum qualifications for each role, we aren’t looking for someone who checks each box on a page; we’re looking for active learners and people who care about disrupting the current healthcare system with their unique experiences.

We do not conduct interviews by text nor will we send you a job offer unless you've interviewed with multiple people, including the Director of People & Talent, over video interviews. Job scams do exist so please be careful with your personal information.

data.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Become a Senior Data Engineer for Bloomreach!

Join our newly formed Datacraft team — the team building the next-generation data platform that powers internal Databricks, the Loomi Marketing Agent with Data Insights capability for Bloomreach Marketing platform. Your engineering work will directly impact how hundreds of enterprise customers access, understand, and activate their Bloomreach data internally and with data share in Databricks and BigQuery.

The base salary range for this position at the P3 / Senior Software Engineer level is CZK 1 300 000 - CZK 1 600 000. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Working in one of our Central European offices (Bratislava, Brno or Prague) or from home on a full-time basis, you'll become a core part of the Engineering team.

What challenge awaits you?

You will join the Datacraft team as one of its founding engineers. Datacraft is a new team in the Engagement pillar, established to tackle three interconnected domains:

  • Data Warehouses (~60% of team domain) — making Bloomreach data first-class in customer Databricks. The strategic goal for 27 is to use Databricks to exponentially accelerate data adoption — both for customers who want their data outside Bloomreach and for Bloomreach itself to build analytics faster.
  • Dashboards & Analytics Stack (~20%) — moving Marketing reporting and dashboarding from the proprietary stack onto Databrick.

Datacraft is an AI-first team. We believe code is a commodity and expect every engineer to fluently use coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI) as a core part of their daily workflow. The ability to leverage AI tooling to accelerate development, prototyping, and problem-solving is not optional — it's foundational. We rely heavily on knowledge graphs and spec driven development.

As a P3 (Senior) engineer at Bloomreach you are an independent professional — expert in at least one component, able to decompose objectives into tasks, and lead small projects end-to-end with minimal day-to-day guidance.

Your job will be to:

  • a. Build the Databricks data platform — Design data pipelines (Kafka → Flink -> GCS Iceberg → Databricks) following medallion architecture using Databricks notebooks and Spark Declarative Pipeline. Own data models and ETL mutations for ID resolution and consent semantics. Maintain orchestration (Airflow / Cloud Composer) and monitoring.
  • b. Co-build dashboards & analytics stack — Design canonical metrics and models on Databricks, support semantic layers and BI tools (Cube, Looker Studio), ensure tight Marketing Agent (Insights skill) integration.

Our tech stack

Python, Go, Kafka, Databricks, Airflow, Flink (Java), GCP, Mongo, Redis, Airflow, DataProc, Spark, Apache Flink, Databricks, Kubernetes, Terraform, Grafana, Prometheus, PagerDuty, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, GitLab CI/CD, Claude Code

Your success story

30 Days: Understand the Datacraft domain, complete onboarding, set up your dev environment, and get oriented on Databricks architecture and Marketing Agent.

90 Days: Ship your first pipeline, data model, or orchestration improvement to production. Join architecture discussions and the on-call rotation.

180 Days: Own a component end-to-end. Make informed trade-off decisions independently. Contribute to measurable team goals.

You have the following experience and qualities:

Professional experience

  • Solid data engineering background with strong SQL and data modeling skills (star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, partitioning/clustering, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience building production-grade data pipelines on Databricks and GCP, ideally involving Flink, Iceberg, Spark on DataProc.
  • Experience with orchestration and workflow tools — specifically Airflow / Cloud Composer — and comfort working with DAG-based systems for scheduled and event-driven jobs.
  • Familiarity with open table formats (Iceberg preferred, Delta Lake / Hudi acceptable) and how they interact with query engines and DWH platforms.
  • Strong programming skills in Python (preferred); Scala/Java/Go also relevant.
  • Good understanding of data quality, lineage, and observability (monitoring SLAs/SLOs, detecting missing/late loads, backfilling strategies).
  • Ability to work across product and engineering teams, turning fuzzy problem statements into incremental, shippable slices.

Strongly preferred

  • Background in marketing analytics, CDPs, or BI/semantic layers (Looker, dbt, Cube).
  • Experience with Snowflake or Databricks or BigQuery.
  • Experience with spec driven development, knowledge graphs, agentic harnesses or AI-powered analytics

Personal qualities

Ownership & accountability · Sharp and Product thinking · Clear communication · Bias for reliability · Continuous improvement mindset · Comfortable remote-first in Central Europe.

#LI-KP1

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.

  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.

  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.

  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.

  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

  • We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.

  • Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*

  • Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.

  • Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

  • The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*

  • Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*

  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

  • We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.

  • Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

  • Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*

  • We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!

  • We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

Role Overview

As the Engineering Manager - Developer Productivity, you will lead a high-impact team focused on improving developer workflows, reducing friction, and enhancing the overall engineering experience. You’ll collaborate across teams to identify bottlenecks, implement scalable solutions, and foster a culture of continuous improvement. Your work will directly influence the speed, quality, and happiness of our engineering organization.

Responsibilities:

  1. Infrastructure & Tooling

    • Oversee the development and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines, build systems, and internal tools, including AI-powered internal tooling and agents.

    • Ensure our developer infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and secure.

    • Evaluate and implement new AI-native technologies, considering token economics, compute costs, and AI spend alongside productivity gains.

  2. Team Leadership & AI People Development

    • Build, mentor, and lead a team of engineers focused on developer productivity.

    • Set clear goals and provide regular feedback to drive team performance in partnership with your Director.

data.description:
Submittal Clerk

  • Work Type: Full-time.

  • Schedule: Standard US business hours, with occasional overtime and weekend work required based on bid schedules and workload demands.

  • Location: 100% Remote.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and specialized administrative professional to serve as a Submittal Clerk. Operating in the critical space between pre-construction and operations, you will be responsible for generating, organizing, and tracking technical product data and comprehensive submittal packages. By meticulously managing the technical document approval process, you will prevent ordering delays and ensure that all proposed materials match project specifications and receive design team approval prior to procurement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Specification Review: Review project specifications and contract documents to precisely identify all required submittals, LEED documentation, warranties, and closeout requirements.

  • Package Assembly: Gather product data sheets, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), color charts, and testing data from manufacturers to assemble comprehensive and accurate submittal packages.

  • Tracking & Follow-Up: Log all outgoing submittals, rigorously track review times, and follow up proactively with General Contractors (GCs) or Architects regarding "Revise and Resubmit" or "Approved as Noted" statuses.

  • Internal Distribution: Distribute approved submittals to the project management and purchasing teams to facilitate accurate, timely material ordering.

  • Project Closeout: Assist in compiling Operations and Maintenance (O&M) manuals and warranty documentation at project completion.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: 1–3 years of professional experience in construction administration, document control, or project engineering.

  • Technical Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to read and navigate construction specifications (specifically Division 7 and Division 8). Familiarity with construction management software (e.g., Procore) for executing submittal workflows.

  • Core Competencies: High attention to detail, accuracy, and rigorous documentation practices. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Must be able to pass a pre-employment screening.

  • Remote Infrastructure: Must have a dedicated, noise-free home office setup equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a backup power source.

Benefits of Working for Hyre

  • Performance-based raises.

The position is remote. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.

The Integration/Middleware Engineer provides advanced technical engineering support for CLIENT's enterprise integration platforms, middleware environments, API management services, and data pipeline infrastructure. This individual brings deep integration engineering expertise to the design, build, operation, and sustainment of CLIENT's enterprise integration environment.

This role is focused specifically on integration engineering and middleware platform operations — the technical discipline of connecting enterprise systems, automating data flows, managing APIs, and ensuring reliable, secure, and performant integration services across CLIENT's on-premises and cloud application portfolio. The Integration / Middleware Engineer works at the platform and architecture level, designing and building integration solutions that enable CLIENT's enterprise applications to communicate and operate effectively as a cohesive enterprise environment.

This individual must demonstrate deep hands-on expertise in enterprise integration platforms, middleware technologies, API management, and data pipeline engineering, with the ability to independently design, build, and troubleshoot complex integrations in a federal enterprise environment that spans on-premises infrastructure, AWS, and Microsoft Azure Government.

Key Responsibilities:

Integration Platform Engineering & Operations:

  • Design, build, configure, and maintain CLIENT's enterprise integration platform and middleware environments, ensuring reliable, secure, and well-performing data flows and system integrations
  • Engineer and maintain integration interfaces, data pipelines, message queues, and event-driven integration workflows across CLIENT's enterprise application portfolio
  • Develop and maintain integration platform configurations, connection management settings, and interface administration procedures
  • Monitor integration platform health, performance, and error rates using Government-provided monitoring tools and dashboards
  • Detect, diagnose, and resolve integration failures, data pipeline errors, and middleware incidents independently for moderately complex issues
  • Escalate complex or cross-domain integration incidents to the Senior Application Operations Engineer or Applications & Integration Lead as appropriate
  • Evaluate integration platform performance and implement engineering improvements that enhance reliability, throughput, and operational efficiency

API Management Engineering:

  • Design, build, and maintain API configurations, policies, and security controls in CLIENT's enterprise API management platform
  • Engineer API gateway configurations, including rate limiting, authentication, authorization, and traffic management policies
  • Develop and maintain API documentation, including endpoint specifications, data schemas, and integration guides
  • Monitor API performance, availability, and security posture, taking proactive action to address issues and prevent service degradation
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex API connectivity, performance, and security issues independently
  • Support API lifecycle management activities, including versioning, deprecation, and retirement of API endpoints
  • Maintain accurate API inventory, endpoint configuration records, and security policy documentation

Middleware Configuration & Administration:

  • Administer and maintain CLIENT's middleware platforms, including message brokers, enterprise service buses, and event streaming platforms as applicable
  • Engineer middleware configurations, including topic management, queue administration, consumer group management, and message routing rules
  • Monitor middleware platform health and performance, taking proactive action to address capacity, performance, and availability issues
  • Support middleware platform upgrades, patching, and version management activities in accordance with ITIL 4 change management practices
  • Develop and maintain middleware administration runbooks, configuration standards, and operational procedures
  • Coordinate with the Infrastructure and Platform Operations team on middleware platform infrastructure requirements and capacity planning

Integration Security Engineering:

  • Engineer integration security configurations aligned with FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, and CLIENT cybersecurity policies
  • Implement secure integration patterns, including encrypted data transmission, certificate management, OAuth 2.0 / SAML authentication, and API security controls
  • Support Zero Trust Architecture implementation across integration platforms in coordination with the Microsoft Infrastructure and Network teams
  • Conduct integration security engineering reviews and provide recommendations for improving CLIENT's integration security posture
  • Manage integration platform certificates, credentials, and secrets in accordance with CLIENT security and key management requirements
  • Support security assessment activities and audit evidence collection for integration platforms and API management services

Cloud Integration Engineering:

  • Engineer and maintain integrations between CLIENT's on-premises systems and cloud environments, including AWS commercial, AWS GovCloud, Microsoft Azure Government, and Microsoft 365
  • Support Azure Integration Services engineering, including Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, and API Management configurations
  • Coordinate with the Microsoft Infrastructure Administrator (Senior) and Infrastructure and Platform Operations team on cloud integration requirements and architecture
  • Engineer and maintain cloud-based data pipeline workflows and event-driven integration patterns
  • Support FedRAMP compliance for cloud-based integration services and API management platforms
  • Maintain accurate cloud integration architecture documentation and configuration records

Integration Testing & Quality Assurance:

  • Develop and execute integration test plans, test cases, and validation procedures for new and modified integration interfaces
  • Conduct integration regression testing to validate that platform changes do not introduce failures or performance degradation
  • Support end-to-end integration testing for application releases and major platform changes
  • Maintain accurate integration test documentation, test results, and defect records in the Government ITSM platform
  • Coordinate with application teams and the Senior Application Operations Engineer on integration test planning and execution
  • Provide integration test results and quality assurance data to support release readiness reviews

Required Qualifications:

Experience:

  • Minimum 4–6 years of hands-on enterprise integration engineering and middleware operations experience
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating enterprise integration platforms and middleware at scale
  • Proven experience with API management platform engineering and API security configuration
  • Experience with data pipeline design and engineering for enterprise application environments
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud integration engineering, including Azure Integration Services or equivalent AWS integration services
  • Experience in a Federal or private-sector enterprise environment of comparable scale, complexity, and security posture
  • Proven ability to independently resolve complex integration and middleware engineering problems
  • Familiarity with FedRAMP-authorized integration platforms and Federal integration security requirements
  • Experience implementing integration security controls aligned with NIST SP 800-53

Technical Expertise:

• Expert-level proficiency in:

  • Enterprise integration platform engineering (e.g., MuleSoft Anypoint, Dell Boomi, Azure Integration Services, IBM MQ, or equivalent)
  • API management platform engineering and security configuration (e.g., Azure API Management, MuleSoft API Gateway, AWS API Gateway)

Additional preferred certifications:

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP ABAP Programmer with strong S/4HANA expertise to design, develop, and support custom enhancements, integrations, and reports within large enterprise SAP landscapes. This role spans the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, hands-on coding, unit testing, performance tuning, and post-go-live support in close collaboration with functional consultants and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate will combine deep ABAP expertise — including core ABAP, ABAP OO, CDS views, AMDPs, and OData — with a strong understanding of S/4HANA architecture, Fiori integration, and clean-core principles that minimize technical debt and ease future upgrades.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom ABAP programs, enhancements, BAPIs, BADIs, user exits, and interfaces within SAP S/4HANA environments, following clean-core and modification-free principles wherever possible.
  • Build performant CDS views, AMDPs, and HANA-optimized ABAP code that leverages code pushdown and takes full advantage of S/4HANA’s in-memory architecture.
  • Develop and consume OData services and RESTful APIs to support Fiori applications and integrations with non-SAP systems.
  • Implement SAP Gateway services, including service registration, modeling, and lifecycle management.
  • Design and develop classical and interactive ALV reports, smart forms, Adobe forms, and modern Fiori-aligned output channels.
  • Build and maintain integration interfaces using IDocs, RFC, BAPI, Web Services, and the SAP API Hub.
  • Perform technical analysis of business requirements in collaboration with functional consultants, and translate them into well-documented technical designs.
  • Conduct thorough unit testing, support functional and integration testing, and resolve defects raised during UAT and post-go-live hypercare.
  • Lead performance tuning of ABAP code, SQL queries, and database access patterns, including the use of SAT, ST05, and HANA-specific diagnostic tools.
  • Support S/4HANA upgrades, system conversions, and code remediation activities, including SCMON / UPL analysis and clean-core readiness assessments.
  • Implement security best practices in custom developments, including authority checks, secure data handling, and compliance with internal SAP governance.
  • Document technical specifications, code reviews, and operational procedures in line with enterprise SAP standards.
  • Mentor junior ABAP developers and act as a technical reference within the SAP team.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with ABAP OO, CDS views, AMDPs, and HANA-optimized ABAP.
  • Solid experience building OData services and integrating with Fiori applications.
  • Hands-on experience with enhancement frameworks (BADIs, user exits, implicit/explicit enhancements).
  • Strong experience with integration technologies (IDoc, RFC, BAPI, Web Services).
  • Solid understanding of SAP module data structures, including FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP, depending on the project area.
  • Experience with performance tuning tools (SAT, ST05) and HANA diagnostic tools.
  • Familiarity with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, and SAP transport management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with S/4HANA system conversions or greenfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP BTP, ABAP RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model), or steampunk.

Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.

As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications.
