Apache Spark Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Apache Spark Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $125,000–$185,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Apache Spark Developer to design, develop, and optimize large-scale distributed data processing applications supporting enterprise analytics, machine learning, real-time reporting, and cloud-based data platforms. This role focuses on building high-performance Spark applications capable of processing billions of records across structured and semi-structured data sources while delivering scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient data pipelines.
You will work closely with data architects, data engineers, cloud platform teams, machine learning engineers, and business intelligence developers to build modern data processing solutions leveraging Apache Spark, cloud-native technologies, and distributed computing frameworks. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Spark architecture, distributed systems, performance optimization, and cloud-based big data ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance distributed data processing applications using Apache Spark.
  • Build scalable batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines processing large volumes of enterprise data.
  • Develop Spark applications using PySpark, Scala, or Spark SQL for data transformation, aggregation, and analytics.
  • Optimize Spark jobs for memory utilization, partitioning strategies, shuffle performance, and execution efficiency.
  • Process structured, semi-structured, and streaming data from enterprise databases, APIs, Kafka, cloud storage, and data lakes.
  • Develop reusable Spark libraries, data processing frameworks, and metadata-driven ingestion pipelines.
  • Collaborate with cloud engineering teams to deploy Spark workloads on Databricks, EMR, Azure Synapse, or Kubernetes.
  • Implement data quality validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and automated error handling across distributed pipelines.
  • Integrate Spark applications with enterprise data warehouses, lakehouses, and reporting platforms.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design discussions, and Agile development activities.
  • Troubleshoot production issues involving distributed processing, cluster performance, resource utilization, and data quality.
  • Support cloud migration initiatives by modernizing legacy ETL workloads into Spark-based architectures.


Required Skills

  • Six or more years of professional software or data engineering experience.
  • Four or more years of hands-on Apache Spark development experience in enterprise production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in PySpark, Scala, or Spark SQL for distributed data processing.
  • Deep understanding of Apache Spark architecture including RDDs, DataFrames, Datasets, Catalyst Optimizer, DAG execution, and Tungsten engine.
  • Strong experience with distributed computing concepts including partitioning, shuffling, caching, broadcast joins, and fault tolerance.
  • Advanced SQL skills with databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or Teradata.
  • Experience working with Hadoop ecosystem technologies including Hive, HDFS, YARN, and Parquet.
  • Experience processing streaming data using Spark Structured Streaming, Apache Kafka, or Event Hubs.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms including Azure Databricks, AWS EMR, AWS Glue, Azure Synapse Analytics, or Google Dataproc.
  • Experience integrating Spark applications with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and data lake architecture.
  • Experience using Git, CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and Spark performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building enterprise Lakehouse architectures using Databricks or Delta Lake.
  • Familiarity with Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Step Functions, or Control-M for workflow orchestration.
  • Experience with machine learning workflows using Spark MLlib, MLflow, or feature engineering pipelines.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized Spark deployments.
  • Experience implementing Data Quality frameworks using Great Expectations or Deequ.
  • Familiarity with Apache NiFi, Apache Flink, Trino, or Presto.
  • Experience working with cloud object storage including Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), or Google Cloud Storage.

  • Experience with enterprise monitoring tools including Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Cloud certifications in Azure, AWS, Databricks, or Apache Spark-related technologies are highly desirable.


Project Environment
You will be joining a modern data engineering team responsible for building cloud-native big data platforms supporting enterprise analytics, AI, and business intelligence initiatives. Current projects include:

  • Enterprise data lakehouse implementation using Databricks and Delta Lake
  • Real-time streaming analytics processing billions of daily events
  • Large-scale customer analytics and behavioral data platforms

  • Cloud migration of legacy Hadoop and ETL workloads

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to distributed system architecture, Spark application development, cloud migration, performance optimization, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise-scale data processing platforms.

data.description:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Data Analytics team.

In this role, you’ll act as a key partner for Product, Data, and Business teams, leading measurement strategies and analytical initiatives to uncover insights that drive strategic and operational decisions.

You’ll work cross-functionally to transform complex data into clear narratives that demonstrate the value of our products and guide smarter business choices.
If you thrive on solving complex analytical problems, enjoy turning data into impactful stories, and love collaborating across teams, this role is for you!

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to identify business questions and translate them into analytical solutions.
  • Translate product requirements into clear data requirements, ensuring data and analytics solutions align with business objectives and product goals.
  • Develop measurement strategies, frameworks, and KPIs to evaluate product and business performance.
  • Design and build dashboards and analytical tools to monitor key initiatives and enable data-driven decision-making.
  • Conduct impact analyses and A/B tests to validate hypotheses and optimize outcomes.
  • Deliver compelling data stories through reports, visualizations, and presentations.
  • Demonstrate the value of Flipp’s products and channels through performance tracking and insight storytelling.
  • Coach and support analysts, fostering best practices in analytical thinking and communication.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Lead.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python or R for data analysis.
  • Advanced knowledge of data visualization and BI tools (e.g. ThoughtSpot, Looker, Power BI, or Tableau).
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or similar).
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. LLMs, prompt engineering) to automate and improve analytical workflows.
  • Strong data acumen and the ability to grasp complex data concepts, enabling effective collaboration with technical teams on analytics infrastructure and data pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of statistics and experimentation methodologies.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into business narratives.
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence decisions through insights.
  • A growth mindset and passion for continuous learning.

At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

LOCATION

While we have an office in Milan, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full-remote available from Italy), empowering you to work where you're most effective. Shopfully and Flipp, a leading Canadian company, are part of the same group: you’ll be hired in Europe while working directly within Flipp’s organization, in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Since you’ll be collaborating with colleagues across different time zones, a bit of schedule flexibility will help you stay connected with our amazing teams in Canada!

If you’re excited about joining a dynamic, international team, working on cutting-edge projects and expanding your career globally, we’d love to hear from you!

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY

An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices

WHO WE ARE

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives.   • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.

  • Challenge with Empathy: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.
  • Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

  • Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

data.description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

You will lead the emerging sector insights team - this involves insights ownership for some of our most high-profile accounts while managing a team dedicated towards category thought leadership and best in class client service.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

We expect East/West Coast/etc. work hours.

As Our Insights Sector Lead You Will:

  • Lead our product strategy for various categories, collaborating with data counterparts to put together product roadmaps that drive meaningful value for our clients
  • Manage a team of talented insights analysts, scaling their impact through effective coaching and through introducing development opportunities
  • Be responsible for the success of the sector commercially, working closely with revenue counterparts on critical upsell and renewal opportunities

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5 years of experience servicing consumer brand clients from a product perspective, specifically within market research
  • You have experience managing others, and enjoy cross functional workflows (with engineering, data, sales, etc)
  • You enjoy using SQL or excel to dive deep into data to surface the most impactful insights

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
  • Base Salary + Variable Compensation: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $160K-170K. This role is eligible for variable compensation, with on-target earnings (OTE) of up to $192K-204K. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

data.description:
Build something people love

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual and learn more about how we work.

About the team

The Fraud Countermeasures team is part of Data Science, and it's how Wealthsimple grows safely. We balance fraud losses with client friction, so legitimate clients can use their money without jumping through hoops. We work in small pods that pair a fraud countermeasures lead with a data scientist and an analytics developer, and we sit alongside Product and Engineering on every new feature launch. We use data to make every decision, and we use AI tools to move faster. If you want to work on hard problems with people who care about craft, you'll fit right in.

About the role

Card fraud is one of the highest-stakes problems at Wealthsimple, and this role owns the strategy for it. You'll set direction for how we prevent application, transaction and account takeover fraud across our card products, and you'll do it independently, with real accountability for the outcome. This is a Staff individual contributor role with manager-level impact: you'll lead through expertise and influence, not direct reports. It's open to candidates in any timezone in Canada.

What you'll do

  • Own fraud strategy and execution across application, transaction and account takeover fraud for Wealthsimple's card products.

  • Manage the card fraud loss budget as our volumes grow, and guard against the fraud attacks that can blow a budget up.

  • Design, backtest, ship and tune detection rules, and set decision thresholds on ML risk scores.

  • Weigh fraud losses prevented against operational cost and client experience before you recommend an approach.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to build controls that stop fraud without blocking legitimate clients, like step-up authentication instead of a hard decline.

  • Guide the data scientists and analytics developers in your pod, and mentor junior teammates on strategy, rule building and problem-solving.

Skills you bring

  • 6+ years of experience in fraud prevention, including 3+ years working directly on card fraud (prepaid or credit) at an issuer, fintech or payments platform.

  • Hands-on ownership of card fraud strategy across application, transaction and account takeover fraud.

  • Advanced SQL. You write complex queries against transaction-level data yourself, without waiting for an analyst to pull it.

  • A track record of building, backtesting, shipping and tuning fraud rules, and explaining the precision, catch rate and approval rate impact of each.

  • Experience quantifying fraud savings against operational and client experience costs to make a clear recommendation.

  • Experience using AI tools in your daily work, and examples of where they changed your output.

  • The ability to influence Product, Engineering, credit risk, operations and external vendors toward a decision without direct authority.

  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

  • Nice to have: Knowledge of Visa and Mastercard network rules, dispute processes and chargeback rails.

Who you are

  • You set direction on your own and take ownership over outcomes for your space, from fighting fraud attacks to minimizing client friction.

  • You make decisions with numbers behind them, and you're honest about what the numbers can't tell you.

  • You lead through influence. You can get a roadmap conversation to go your way by rallying others around shared objectives.

  • You use AI to aide in your workflow, and know when to question it’s outputs

  • You share what you know, and you make the people around you sharper

Why Wealthsimple?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles.

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.

These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

data.title: Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance

experience_requirements.text: 7+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, and data management within the fintech, crypto, financial services, or gambling industry, gained in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We're looking for a Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance to join our team remotely! The primary goal of this role is to elevate decision-making by uncovering emerging trends and root causes, and by driving insights and actions that provide full visibility into business performance and operational efficiency.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with strategic thinking to deliver actionable recommendations, guide decision-making, and drive measurable impact across the organization.

In this role, you'll own end-to-end data management, from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and delivering insights for the Compliance team. A core part of this role is owning the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals. You'll also contribute to experimentation infrastructure, laying the groundwork for future ML and intelligence initiatives.

The opportunity

  • Own the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals, partnering closely with Compliance to study patterns and refine detection logic

  • Translate compliance requirements into production detection logic, preserving correctness across alert eligibility, thresholds, customer segmentation, date windows, and deduplication

  • Develop and maintain Python and SQL pipelines for transaction data preparation, feature engineering, and detection workflows

  • Evaluate detection rules and analytical models across coverage, alert quality, threshold sensitivity, and the impact of proposed changes

  • Design reproducible evaluations on historical data that account for limited labels, class imbalance, and shifts in customer behaviour over time

  • Own testing, deployment, scheduling, monitoring, and operational support for detection workflows, including investigating data quality issues, pipeline failures, and unexpected changes in detection results

  • Execute historical backfills with clear validation and traceability, and maintain reliable downstream alert delivery and integrations with compliance systems

  • Be at the forefront of data innovation by experimenting, testing hypotheses, and translating insights into action, while incorporating software engineering best practices into pipelines and dashboards.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, and data management within the fintech, crypto, financial services, or gambling industry, gained in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Experience working with compliance, fraud, funding, finance, and customer support teams and analyzing large datasets, engineering features, and applying statistical methods to practical business problems

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and supporting production data or analytical systems

  • Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high-fidelity data for reporting and decision-making

  • Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of workflow orchestration, plus strong software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD

  • Solid statistical foundation; ML exposure is a strong plus

  • Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Hex, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to build executive-facing dashboards

  • Ability to investigate production issues independently and communicate technical findings and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders

  • You believe wholeheartedly in the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document

  • A degree in a field emphasizing analytical rigor, such as analytics, software engineering, statistics, or economics

  • Based in Canada, the US, or Brazil, and fluent in English

Nice to haves

  • Fraud detection, AML, anomaly detection, or other risk applications

  • Experience with Athena, Trino, Kafka, and Kubernetes alongside the core Airflow/dbt/S3 stack

  • Transaction pattern analysis, customer segmentation, and detection threshold tuning

  • Developing or productionising machine learning models, including experiment tracking and performance monitoring

  • Working with sparse or delayed feedback from investigations to evaluate and improve detection

  • Explainability, auditability, and change control in regulated environments

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

data.title: Analyst, Strategy & Analytics

experience_requirements.text: 1+ years of experience in analytics, data science, finance, management consulting, or another analytical role where data-driven analysis and execution were critical to success

data.description:
Who We Are

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.

We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

What We Build

Our products—Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom, Geodes, and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

  • Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.

  • Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Where We’re Headed

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.


Job Purpose

Great Minds is looking for an analytically minded, and strategically curious professional to join our Strategy and Analytics team as an Analyst, Strategy & Analytics. Our team partners with leaders across the enterprise on Great Minds’ more important strategic priorities. We use data to inform strategy, evaluate performance, and help the organization accelerate progress toward its goals.

In this role, you will use data to drive insights, helping leaders across the organization understand what is happening and why, make the case for change, implement process improvements, and build analytical tools to support these changes.


Responsibilities

The duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand their highest-priority issues that can be addressed with data, prototypes, discussion, and mock-ups

  • Track down and integrate the critical datasets needed to uncover actionable insights, building expertise in our data systems and structures across operational, financial and accounting, customer management, and digital platform applications

  • Perform critical analyses across disparate sources using a variety of analytical tools and methods to derive actionable insights

  • Create compelling cases for change through targeted analytics and storytelling, tailored for senior leaders

  • Apply rapid-cycle hypothesis testing and proofs of concept to help build and scale new tools, processes, and ways of working

  • Contribute to team-wide strategic projects that elevate business understanding, improve operational efficiency, and build data infrastructure and reporting capabilities

Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in analytics, data science, finance, management consulting, or another analytical role where data-driven analysis and execution were critical to success

  • Strong analytical skills, with familiarity with SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)

  • Experience using data to uncover advanced business and customer insights

  • Experience creating compelling presentations that concisely share data and insights in a form suitable for senior leaders

  • Intellectual curiosity and comfort navigating ambiguity and unfamiliar domains

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences

  • Ability to work across multiple projects and balance competing demands, with strong time management skills

  • Team player with a commitment to excellence and a high level of integrity

Qualifications

  • Interest in K-12 public education and an understanding of how data can drive change, from leadership to the classroom

  • Working knowledge of the full data analytics pipeline (e.g., data gathering, ETL, automation, engineering, databases and storage, cleaning and reshaping, analysis, visualization), including data models, database design, data mining, and segmentation techniques

  • Experience working with data from CRM and ERP systems

  • Experience in consulting, transformation, or project-based environments

Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Math, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline


Status

Full-time, permanent

Location

Remote

The expected base salary range for this position is $61,000-$70,000, however the offered salary may be higher or lower than the above range dependent on numerous factors including, but not limited to location, work experience, skills and internal equity considerations. The base salary is not inclusive of benefits or other incentives.

A cover letter and resume are required to be considered for this position.

New employees will be required to successfully complete a background check.

Any communication to applicants relating to the Great Minds hiring process will only come from email addresses with the domains greatminds.org or greatminds.recruitee.com. If in the course of the application or hiring process with Great Minds you are contacted through another domain, are requested to provide banking or other sensitive information, or you note any other suspicious activity, please contact security@greatminds.org

We will extend equal opportunity to all individuals without regard to race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability, age, genetic information, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws. About the role:

We are looking for a Senior Associate to own credit policy for our business lending products, starting with a business credit card — from adjudication through the full account lifecycle. You will design and implement the underwriting framework that determines who qualifies and at what limit, build the line management strategies that govern how those limits evolve, and partner closely with collections to manage risk once accounts are on book.

Small business cards can be underwritten on the owner, or on the business as it grows. You’ll be working with cash flow, seasonality, industry, and business bureau data, which is usually thinner and messier than consumer bureau data. We need someone who has worked across that range and can turn it into automated policy instead of file-by-file decisions.

You will collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Fraud, and Client Experience to translate policy into shippable adjudication and monitoring systems, and you will have significant ownership over how this portfolio’s risk appetite is defined from day one.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Build a new lending program from the ground up with the breadth to see every part of it, from policy to funding, and the runway to grow into leading a lending line of business.

  • Design and own the adjudication policy for a new business credit card, including entity-level underwriting criteria, principal/guarantor assessment, joint-liability, initial limit-setting, and approval decisioning.

  • Own line management strategy for business credit products: credit limit increases and decreases, pricing, authorization rules, and active exposure management driven by cash-flow and balance monitoring.

  • Partner with the collections team to design risk-managed treatment strategies specific to business accounts, and to build lifecycle monitoring that catches emerging risk early.

  • Evaluate the performance of the business lending portfolio and your policies, using vintage analysis, cohort tracking, and champion/challenger testing to validate and refine underwriting decisions.

  • Propose policy enhancements that improve marginal profitability while keeping risk within appetite, informed by rigorous root-cause analysis rather than surface-level metrics.

  • Help define the data and underwriting infrastructure needed for SMB lending — including how to source, validate, and weigh business financial data alongside traditional bureau signals.

  • Influence roadmaps across partner teams (Engineering, Product, Data Science, Fraud, and Client Experience) and implement policy that drives measurable impact.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has direct experience underwriting or setting credit policy for small and medium-sized businesses, this is a must-have for this role. Card experience isn't required; we'd love to hear from you if your background is in instalment loans or lines of credit.

  • Writes SQL hands-on to self-serve data and build monitoring and analytics.

  • Brings credit discipline to a ship-and-iterate environment, and is comfortable shaping policy while the product itself is still being defined.

  • Can turn analysis into a clear recommendation for technical and non-technical audiences, weigh incomplete or noisy information and still reach well-grounded decisions.

  • Is intellectually curious, passionate about their work, and wants ownership over their projects.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in small business lending

  • Knowledge of Canadian consumer credit bureau data (Equifax, TransUnion)

  • Working knowledge of how business credit risk differs from consumer credit risk: entity vs. personal guarantor assessment, business bureau data (e.g., business credit bureaus), cash-flow-based underwriting, industry/sector risk, and revenue seasonality.

  • Experience across the credit lifecycle: adjudication policy, line management, pricing, and collections strategy.

  • Experience with statistical/quantitative analysis: experimental design, champion/challenger (or A/B) testing, model accuracy validation, constrained optimization, decision trees, discounted cash flows, financial modeling.

  • Experience with Python, and GitHub. Airflow, AWS Redshift, and dbt are a plus.

data.description:
About Invisible

Invisible Technologies makes AI work. Our end-to-end AI platform structures messy data, automates digital workflows, deploys agentic solutions, measures outcomes, and integrates human expertise where it matters most.

Our platform cleans, labels, and structures company data so it is ready for AI. It adapts models to each business and adds human expertise when needed, the same approach we have used to improve models for more than 80% of the world’s top AI companies, including Microsoft, AWS, and Cohere.

Our successes span industries, from supply chain automation for Swiss Gear to AI-enabled naval simulations with SAIC, and validating NBA draft picks for the Charlotte Hornets.

Profitable for more than half a decade, Invisible reached $134M in revenue and ranked as the number two fastest growing AI company on the 2024 Inc. 5000. In September 2025, we raised $100M in growth capital to accelerate our mission of making AI actually work in the enterprise and to advance our platform technology.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to set the technical strategy for Data Labs, the team that builds the benchmarking systems, data pipelines, and RL environments behind our AI training engagements. The frontier labs and enterprises we work with are changing how they train, evaluate, and deploy models every quarter. Your job is to see where that market is going and make sure Data Labs is built for it before our clients ask.

You'll decide which capabilities we invest in, which we standardize into platform, and which we leave to individual engagements. You'll track how training methods, evaluation practices, and data needs are shifting across the industry, and turn that into a technical roadmap and a point of view our commercial and research teams can sell against.

You'll lead a group of engineering managers, forward deployed engineers (FDEs), and senior ICs, and partner closely with applied research, product, and go-to-market leadership. This is a hands-on strategic role. You won't spend much time writing code, but you'll stay close enough to the technical work to make and defend hard architectural calls, and close enough to clients to know which calls matter.

What You'll Do

Technical Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the multi-year technical strategy for Data Labs, and translate it into a roadmap tied to where the AI training and evaluation market is heading.
  • Decide where to build shared platform versus engagement-specific solutions, weighing reuse against team autonomy so platforms speed teams up rather than creating over-dependency.
  • Set architectural direction for benchmarking infrastructure, data pipelines, and RL environments so they stay reproducible, portable across client deployments, and ready for the next generation of training methods.
  • Anticipate technical shifts 6–18 months out, such as new post-training techniques, agentic evaluation, and synthetic data, and place the bets that keep Invisible ahead of them.
  • Set expectations for how AI is used in design reviews and day-to-day engineering work.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning

  • Build a clear, current view of how frontier labs and enterprises are training, evaluating, and deploying models, and what that means for the data and infrastructure they'll need from us.
  • Track the competitive landscape across AI data, evaluation, and RL environment providers, and help define where Invisible differentiates.
  • Turn client signals, research developments, and market trends into investment recommendations for executive leadership.
  • Partner with product and commercial teams to shape new offerings, pricing logic, and the technical story behind them.

Evaluation & Data Strategy

  • Define Invisible's point of view on benchmarking and evaluation, including pre- and post-engagement comparisons, capability gap analyses, and regression tracking.
  • Make sure evaluation design ties to client-defined success metrics, validate automated checks against human judgment, and be explicit about what each approach can't see.
  • Identify reusable data assets, frameworks, and pipelines that become durable advantages and improve margins across engagements.
  • Shape practices for data licensing, privacy, and contamination risk as a strategic differentiator, not just a compliance requirement.

Client & Executive Engagement

  • Represent engineering in executive conversations, strategic client relationships, and pre-sales, translating technical reality into clear, honest narratives.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to client research and engineering leaders, bringing back what you learn to inform the roadmap.
  • Help leaders weigh client-specific asks against broader platform and business goals, with clear short- and long-term paths.

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and grow an engineering org of multiple teams, including engineering managers, senior managers, FDEs, and Staff+ ICs.
  • Coach managers to build sound technical judgment and strategic awareness in their teams.
  • Build hiring pipelines that reinforce a rigorous, client-focused, strategy-aware engineering culture.
  • Make sure the org has the planning, quality, and operational practices it needs to execute on the strategy reliably, delegating day-to-day delivery to strong managers.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with significant experience building ML or AI systems.
  • 5+ years in engineering leadership, including experience managing managers across multiple teams.
  • A track record of setting multi-year technical strategy and making platform investment decisions that paid off commercially.
  • Deep, current understanding of the AI training and evaluation landscape, including how frontier labs and enterprises approach fine-tuning, RLHF/RLAIF, and evaluation methodology.
  • Hands-on familiarity with LLM training pipelines, deep enough to make and defend architectural decisions.
  • Experience building benchmarking, data curation, or RL infrastructure that produced measurable client outcomes.
  • Ability to read market and competitive signals and turn them into a technical roadmap and a clear product point of view.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership with applied research, product, and commercial teams.
  • Excellent executive communication, and confidence acting as a technical advisor in client and pre-sales conversations.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at an AI services firm, applied research consultancy, frontier lab, or enterprise AI product company.
  • A visible point of view on the AI data and evaluation market, such as talks, writing, or open-source work.
  • Familiarity with data licensing, synthetic data generation, or contamination detection involving client data.
  • Experience shaping new product lines or service offerings from a technical foundation.
  • Experience leading an org through rapid growth or significant change.

What’s In It For You

Invisible is committed to fair and competitive pay, ensuring that compensation reflects both market conditions and the value each team member brings. Our salary structure accounts for regional differences in cost of living while maintaining internal equity.

For this position, the annual salary will include a 20% annual bonus and an additional incentive structure. The base salary range for SF/NY are:

Salary Range

$252,000—$300,000 USD

You can find more information about our geographic pay tiers here. During the interview process, your Invisible Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm which tier applies to your location. For candidates outside the U.S., compensation is adjusted to reflect local market conditions and cost of living.

*Bonuses and equity are included in all full-time offers. Final compensation is determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, internal pay equity, and overall market conditions. Because of this, every offer is unique. Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

What It's Like to Work at Invisible:

At Invisible, we’re not just redefining work—we’re reinventing it. We operate at the intersection of advanced AI and human ingenuity, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to unlock productivity and scale. Ownership is at the core of everything we do. Here, you won’t just execute tasks—you’ll build, innovate, and shape the future alongside world-class clients pushing the boundaries of AI.

We expect bold ideas, relentless drive, and the ability to turn ambiguity into opportunity. The pace is fast, the challenges are big, and the growth is unmatched. We’re not for everyone, and we’re okay with that. If you’re looking for predictable routines, this isn’t the place for you. But if you’re driven to create, thrive in dynamic environments, and want a front-row seat to the AI revolution, you’ll fit right in.

While some roles may offer remote flexibility, most positions involve in-office collaboration and are tied to specific locations. Any location-based requirements or hybrid expectations will be communicated by our Talent Acquisition team during the recruiting process.

data.description:
Remote, worldwide · Freelance course project with a path to full-time

We’re hiring on behalf of a global hands-on tech-education platform used by over a million engineers to learn DevOps, cloud, Kubernetes and AI. Its courses are built around real labs, not slides, and taught by practising engineers who are great on camera.

We’re looking for a machine learning practitioner who loves teaching to create and present ML courses for engineers, from foundations to training their own models.

This role suits you if you already teach as part of what you do: you’ve published courses on Udemy, Pluralsight, Coursera or YouTube, written a book, taught at a university or bootcamp, or regularly run workshops and talks.

How it works

  • It starts with one paid course project. You can do it alongside your current job. There’s no fixed weekly-hour requirement, just a delivery plan you agree on together. A typical project takes around 3 months.

  • The goal is long-term. The team is growing its internal trainer pool, and the first project is how both sides find out if it’s a fit. After that, it can lead to a full-time role or more course projects.

  • A fixed fee per course is agreed upfront, based on course length and topic complexity. Fees are competitive, and advanced topics and exceptional instructors are paid accordingly. Payment is made on delivery of the completed course.

  • Fully remote with flexible hours. Expect a weekly sync, Slack communication, and some time-zone overlap with a Europe/Asia-based team.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the course with the curriculum team: sections, lessons, labs and notebooks.

  • Write lab specs that a dedicated labs team builds, then test them.

  • Write and narrate short, story-driven video lessons (about 6 minutes each) that make ML intuitive. You’re welcome to use AI to draft, but the final script should sound like you.

  • Record demo and lab-solution walkthroughs.

  • Work through structured editorial feedback, especially on your first section.

Video editing, animation, lab infrastructure and publishing are all handled by the production team. You focus on the teaching.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong, hands-on ML foundations: you’ve trained, evaluated and shipped models yourself (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow).

  • The ability to explain the “why” behind ML clearly to engineers new to it.

  • Excellent spoken and written English. All courses are scripted, narrated and delivered in English, so you need clear, natural, easily understood English and confidence on camera.

  • A genuine passion for teaching, shown through courses, tutorials, talks, workshops or mentoring you’ve done because you enjoy it.

  • Current with the field and keen to keep learning.

  • Clear, engaging spoken English and confidence on camera.

  • Openness to an established teaching methodology and to editorial feedback.

Nice to have

  • Published online courses, a book, or university/bootcamp teaching experience.

  • Experience with fine-tuning, MLOps or deploying models in production.

  • Cloud ML certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks).

How to apply
Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, plus a link that shows how you teach: a course, a talk, a tutorial or a short video.

Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity 

As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects).

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs.
  • You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
  • You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
  • You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions.
  • You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices.
  • You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability.
  • You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility.
  • You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability.
  • You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
  • You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution.
  • You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies.
  • You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working.
  • You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions.

You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management.
  • Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala.
  • Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies.
  • Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies.
  • Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services.
  • Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Databricks experience or certification.
  • Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services.
  • Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks.
  • Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you 

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. 

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: 

Mexico Benefits: 

Medical Insurance 
Savings Fund
Life Insurance
Internet and Electricity Allowance
Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers   #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

 

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/.

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

  • Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

  • Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

  • Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

  • Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

  • Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

  • Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

  • Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Headquarters:

Summary

We are seeking an Analytics Engineer / BI Lead for Channel Insights to define the semantic layer, build dashboards, and present verified insights to leadership. This role combines Tableau Next and Data 360 insight development, SQL/SOQL work, data-quality validation, field-user training, and daily use of AI copilots/agents to improve delivery speed while maintaining accountability for production decisions.

General information

This engagement is centered on Channel Insights, with responsibility spanning metrics, dimensions, refresh SLAs, dashboard logic, and executive-facing insight delivery. The work is not a report ticket queue; it requires ownership of the analytics layer and confidence in the numbers presented to leadership.

Daily use of AI copilots/agents is an explicit expectation for discovery, build, test, and documentation. The focus is on improving cycle time and cost-to-outcome versus legacy delivery, embedding automation into quality gates, and verifying outputs before they reach production or executive readouts.

Tasks and Deliverables

Own Channel Insights metrics, dimensions, and refresh SLAs with the CDP product owner and Data Expert.

Build Tableau Next and Data 360 calculated insights; write SQL/SOQL as needed.

Validate data quality with the modeler/engineer and fix breaks at the source.

Train field users through working sessions.

Use AI for SQL and dataset drafts and insight narratives; verify every number before executive readouts.

Automate anomaly commentary on Channel Insights where trustworthy; escalate false positives.

Required experience

5+ years of analytics engineering or BI lead experience.

Expert-level Tableau or equivalent BI platform experience.

Strong storytelling with data for executives and field leaders.

Experience using AI copilots/agents in analytics delivery with human verification.

Nice to have:

Experience with Salesforce CRM Analytics and/or Data 360.

Engagement highlights

Own a defined Channel Insights workstream across semantic-layer design, dashboards, and data quality.

Work directly with cross-functional stakeholders, including product, data, engineering, and field users.

Deliver executive-facing insights and automate repeatable commentary where the data is trustworthy.
